subject.title: fix(tools): surface empty availability group diagnostics via onHiddenDiagnostic callback

question: Should this PR be accepted as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92361 with warn-only preservation of plugin-authored availability-like metadata?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but overlapping sibling PRs and the new treatment of plugin-authored `availability`-like records require maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept this warn-only path
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after exact-head checks because it covers the planner callback, plugin registration wiring, and malformed metadata guards without changing returned tool visibility.

options.title: Choose a narrower sibling
options.body: Select another open PR if maintainers prefer planner-only or descriptor-registration-only diagnostics, then close this PR after that path lands.

options.title: Request a different contract
options.body: Ask for a revised patch if maintainers want malformed plugin availability to filter returned tools rather than only warn.

recommendation.title: Accept this warn-only path
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after exact-head checks because it covers the planner callback, plugin registration wiring, and malformed metadata guards without changing returned tool visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision centers on plugin descriptor-cache behavior and compatibility, where the history points most strongly to this owner.
